notes_for_editor: Register and the 2020 NM chapter report agree on design, 1934 erection, 1984 remodel and no staffing. Open point: the 1934 newspaper item (quoted on Weebly) refers to the lookout in April 1934; the story says a lookout was in use that spring and does not claim an earlier structure. Not verified: current staffing (NHLR staffing line is undated; 2020 report is the latest source read), access route, and whether Negrito is listed for rent. The Weebly page's access text was not read, and the Divide Trail #15 page does not mention this lookout, so no trailhead is given. The record's 1984 note says the remodel cost it National Register eligibility; the 2020 report attributes ineligibility to loss of integrity, which the remodel plausibly caused, but the report does not name the remodel as the cause, so no correction is proposed. Record coordinates and elevation match the Register. No photos added.
